svg.title: Tracking Monkey Typing: commits, lines, and tokens
svg.desc: Tracking Monkey Typing shows aggregate weekly commits and line movement, followed by anonymous Codex and Claude family token history on the same five-year date domain when history is available. Code movement, last five years at weekly grain. Totals: 3,938 commits, 22,490,223 additions, 21,100,463 deletions, and 137 active weeks. The commit axis uses log1p; the signed additions and deletions axis uses symmetric log. Rounded combined agent lifetime: 71.3B tokens, observed Aug 2, 2026. 4 completed-day family observations from Jul 29, 2026 through Aug 1, 2026. Dates before tracking began are unobserved, not zero. The token axis is linear from zero and shares the five-year date domain used by the code plots. Multi-day observation gaps are dashed. Protected Codex account readings are aggregated before publication; Claude covers retained local usage; per-account readings and identities are not published. Provenance: automatic refresh. Exact family totals: Codex 70,731,538,803 tokens and Claude 593,643,196 tokens. Displayed shares are Codex 99.17% and Claude 0.83%. The approximate conversion is ~$56.3K using this site's current blended public API replay rate of 0.789625 dollars per million tokens as of 2026-07-12; it is not an actual bill.
svg.text: Five years of code movement and recent Codex + Claude token history
